metadata.text:
HP: 4 | DC: 4+ | AT: 1

This room can be attacked.
------------------------------
Each time this takes damage, gain 4¢ or loot 1,
then you may cancel your attack on this.
------------------------------
-Indomitable-
------------------------------
Rewards: +1 treasure

Each time a monster dies, the active
player gains ¢ equal to its HP.
------------------------------
Each ↷ ability on an item or
character becomes a $ ability
with "$: Pay 3¢:".

When this enters play, choose a card
outside the game named Soul of Guppy.
It becomes an active bonus soul.
------------------------------
↷: Look at the top 5 cards of the treasure
deck. You may gain up to 1 Guppy item
from among them. Put the rest on the
bottom of the deck in a random order.

Each time an attack is declared,
each non-active player teams up
with the attacking player.
------------------------------
If a non-active player kills a
monster, they also gain its rewards.
